features.name: Human fixed baseline
features.text: Fixed ability adjustments and speed from species entry.

features.name: Human traits
features.text:
3.1 Human
Humans are the baseline of the Imperium: adaptable, 
ambitious, fragile, and dangerously determined.
Ability Scores: +2 to one ability score and +1 to 
another.
Size: Medium.
Speed: 30 ft.
Available Classes: Veteran, Zealot, Psyker, Arbites 
Enforcer, Hive Scum.
3.1.1 Human Traits
Imperial Adaptability: Gain proficiency in one skill of 
your choice.
Broad Training: Gain one additional weapon, tool, or 
language proficiency.
Faith, Fear, or Discipline: Once per long rest, when you 
fail a saving throw, you may reroll it. You must
use the new result.

features.name: Schola Progenium benefits
features.text:
4.6 Schola Progenium
Raised in harsh Imperial institutions to become a soldier, 
judge, officer, priest, or specialist.
Allowed Species: Human.
Skill Proficiency: Choose one from History or Religion, 
and one from Intimidation or Persuasion.
Drilled Obedience: You have advantage on saving 
throws against fear while following a direct order,
holding formation, or protecting an Imperial objective.
Imperial Education: You can identify major Imperial 
organisations, ranks, symbols, rites, and
procedures.

features.name: Veteran training and hit die
features.text:
11.1 Veteran
Professional soldier, marksman, squad leader, or hardened guardsman.
Allowed Species: Human, Ratling.
Hit Die: d10.
Primary Abilities: Dexterity, Wisdom.
Saving Throws: Dexterity, Wisdom.
Armour: Light, medium, flak, carapace.
Weapons: Simple weapons, martial melee weapons, pistols, basic firearms, grenades.

features.name: Twitchy
features.text:
Trait: Twitchy
Effect: Gain +2 to initiative.

features.name: Guardsman Training
features.text:
Gain proficiency in two skills from Athletics, Insight, 
Intimidation, Medicine, Perception, Stealth, and Survival. 
You also gain proficiency with one specialist weapon 
group: sniper weapons, plasma weapons, melta 
weapons, or heavy weapons.

features.name: Tactical Aim
features.text:
As a bonus action, choose one creature you can see 
within weapon range. Until the end of your turn,
your next ranged weapon attack against that creature 
deals bonus damage equal to your proficiency
bonus.
